messages: Include my current setup in the first delivery: Reploy running inside WSL2, using Docker Desktop’s Linux-container engine. Record the tested versions and filesystem locations.
This is meant for public use. WSL and general Windows, Linux and Mac support.
nothing new here I think. Reploy is already for all those environments.
disposition: Inherit existing public Reploy host support. The agent incorrectly treated platform support as a new owner choice. WSL2/Desktop is one required qualification case, not the entire delivery cohort.
workloads: Linux containers; first OmegaFlow qualified workload remains linux/amd64
acceptance: Complete public inspection -> admission -> launch with success, relevant refusal/no-bootstrap, cancellation and cleanup cases on supported host/engine combinations. Retain exact versions, architecture and filesystem/storage locations. Keep identical integrity guarantees.
requirements_approval: Reuse unchanged requirements R1-R11 and prior actual approval; this instruction clarifies existing host coverage and required qualification without approving an HLD, LLD or implementation.
